Based on my search, here's what I found about watching MSNBC live streaming free online:

## Official Ways to Watch MSNBC Live

**MSNBC is primarily a cable/paid channel**, so there is no completely free official live stream without some form of subscription or trial. However, there are several legitimate options:

### Free Trial Options (Temporary Free Access)
- **fuboTV** – Offers a **7-day free trial** that includes MSNBC in its Pro package ($79.99/month after trial)
- **Hulu + Live TV** – Offers a **3-day free trial** that includes MSNBC ($76.99/month after trial)
- **Sling TV (Blue package)** – Often has promotional trials; MSNBC is included in Sling Blue starting at $50.99/month

### Streaming Services with MSNBC
| Service | Monthly Cost | Free Trial |
|---------|-------------|------------|
| fuboTV Pro | $79.99 | 7 days |
| Hulu + Live TV | $76.99 | 3 days |
| Sling Blue | $50.99 | Varies |
| YouTube TV | $82.99 | Usually has trial |
| Peacock Premium | Varies | Some free content |

### MSNBC.com Live Stream
If you have a cable or streaming TV subscription, you can log into **msnbc.com** with your provider credentials to watch the live stream online at no extra cost.

## Important Note About "Free" Streaming Sites

Various websites claim to offer free MSNBC live streams (such as livenewsnow.com, livenewstime.com, streamfare.net, ufreetv.com, and freeintertv.com). However, these **unofficial third-party streaming sites** often:
- Operate in legal gray areas
- May contain excessive ads, malware, or poor video quality
- Could be shut down without notice
- Don't support the network or its journalists

## MSNBC Rebranding Note
MSNBC is rebranding to **"MS NOW"** (My Source for News, Opinion, and the World) as of November 15, 2024, following its separation from NBCUniversal into a new entity called Versant. The core programming remains the same.
